messages:
Ava (Marketing): Quick sync — the benchmarking webinar ended with ~1.2k registrants, ~730 attended. Need a concise post-webinar engagement flow + lead routing plan. Draft below.
Ravi (Growth): Awesome. Are we sending the same replay to attendees + no-shows? what's the primary KPI — trial signups or PQLs?
Ava (Marketing): Primary KPI = trial signups / PQLs for SDR follow-up. Secondary = content engagement (blog downloads, replay watch time).
Maya (Content): I can draft two subject-line tracks and two body lengths (short exec + long technical). ETA Wed EOD.
Jon (Analytics): I'll create segments: attended (>=10% watch), registered-no-show, clicked-replay, high-engagement (>=50% watch or asked a question). Will add tracking events: webinar_replay_click, webinar_watch_pct.
Elena (Demand Gen): Routing rules proposal: watch_pct >= 50% OR asked_question -> tag as "webinar_hot" -> route to SDR Pool A. Registered-no-show who click replay -> nurture sequence, SDR Pool B for repeats.
Nora (Ops): Ops checklist: suppress emails to current trial users and folks who unsubscribed; throttle ESP to 10k/hr; ensure no duplicate sends for newsletter subscribers. I'll handle suppression list and send windows.
sequence-bot: Recording uploaded: https://drive.redwood.example/webinars/benchmarking-gen2-models (file: benchmark-gen2-2026-03-19.mp4)
Ava (Marketing): Proposed cadence (rough):
```
0h: Replay + TL;DR + primary CTA (attended + reg-no-show)
24h: Deep-dive blog + secondary CTA to try (reg-no-show only)
72h: Case study + invite to office hours (attended)
7d: Last-chance trial offer + product tour (all segments)
```
Ravi (Growth): Let's A/B test subject lines: A) "Benchmark results you can run today" vs B) "How we cut inference cost by 3x". Also test CTA placement (header vs footer).
Maya (Content): I'll produce: 1) Short exec copy with social proof line, 2) Long technical copy with benchmark snippets and chart image. Also two subject lines per audience.
Jon (Analytics): Experiment id = webinar_post_v2. I'll instrument open -> replay_click -> signup funnel and add UTM tags: utm_campaign=webinar_bench_2026, utm_medium=email, utm_content=variantA/B.
Elena (Demand Gen): SDRs need these CRM fields on lead push: watch_pct, q_count, last_interaction_ts, utm_campaign, utm_content. Also a boolean pql_webinar_hot. Can we include watch_pct as numeric?
Nora (Ops): Yes, CRM mapping ok. I'll coordinate field names with Zapier team and set suppression window = 14 days after last send. Also setting bounce handling and retry.
Ava (Marketing): Action items / owners: Maya -> email copy by Wed EOD; Ravi -> sequence config + A/B setup by Thu AM; Jon -> analytics + experiment tracking by Thu EOD; Nora -> suppression/send ops by Fri. @Elena confirm routing rules to SDRs.
Elena (Demand Gen): Confirmed. I'll update the SDR playbook, include routing examples and nightly sync for leads tagged pql_webinar_hot.
Ravi (Growth): Quick ask — can we surface replay-watch heatmap for high-engagement leads? would help SDRs prioritize.
Jon (Analytics): I'll add watch_heatmap metric to the lead profile API within 48h.
Ava (Marketing): Great. Keep updates here — if anything changes, ping in this thread. :rocket: :thumbsup:
Maya (Content): noted, I'll drop copy drafts in the thread when ready.
Nora (Ops): Ops will post send schedule and suppression lists before Friday send window.
Elena (Demand Gen): Thanks team — routing doc will be in the playbook repo by EOD today.
Ava (Marketing): Closing loop — please add any blockers ASAP. Otherwise we'll proceed with this plan.
